title: Strict conversion, calculation and boundary routing
turns: Read orders.csv as strings. Coerce qty to integer and price to integer with type_coerce; these prices are whole currency units. Send rows with failed conversion unchanged to quarantine.csv; do not drop them or invent defaults. For valid rows use value_transform to calculate total=qty*price. Route totals at least 20 to large.csv and the rest to small.csv. Use field_mapper to output only id,qty,price,total in that order on success; retain exactly id,qty,price in that order on quarantine. Validate and preview.

review_policy.constraints: Inspect each presented draft against every explicit requirement in turns. Accept only matching meanings; never approve a changed output, dropped row, weaker type or unrelated requirement. Source data must match supplied input bytes; any model choice must retain the approved sonnet profile.
